definitions.gloss: deep-fried thin tofu; fried tofu pouch
definitions.explanation: Thin slices of tofu that have been deep-fried until golden and puffy. Has a distinctive texture - crispy outside, spongy inside - that absorbs flavors well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{油揚|あぶらあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add fried tofu to the miso soup.

examples.japanese: {油揚|あぶらあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧いなり{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Open the fried tofu pouches to make inari sushi.

examples.japanese: {油揚|あぶらあ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{油抜|あぶらぬ}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Remove excess oil from the fried tofu before using.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil) + {揚|あ}げ (deep-frying)

Literally "oil-fried" - tofu that has been deep-fried.

PREPARATION:
{油抜|あぶらぬ}き (removing excess oil) is often done by:
- Pouring boiling water over the tofu
- Briefly blanching in hot water
This removes excess oil and helps it absorb other flavors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ - miso soup
- いなり{寿司|ずし} - inari sushi (sushi rice stuffed in sweetened pouches)
- きつね⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ - udon with fried tofu
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ - simmered dishes
- ⟦{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}→炊き込みご飯：05883_takikomigohan⟧ - mixed rice

FORMS:
- {油揚|あぶらあ}げ - thin fried tofu
- ⟦{厚揚|あつあ}げ→厚揚げ：07478_atsuage⟧ - thick fried tofu (different texture)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Shinto folklore, foxes (⟦{狐|きつね}→狐：04337_kitsune⟧) are believed to love {油揚|あぶらあ}げ. This is why "きつね" dishes (like きつね⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧) contain fried tofu.
